persona: MBA student or alumnus switching function or industry into consulting, product or strategy

scope.constraints: No product, code or persisted account data changes, account creation, sign-in, provider calls, messages, purchases or installations. Synthetic guest text entered and guest files downloaded for inspection. Only the two owned report files were written in the repository. Unit-test counts were not used as customer evidence.

scoring.scale: 1–100: 1 unusable for this need; 50 partially useful with substantial gaps; 75 useful with material limitations; 100 convincingly complete for this persona.
scoring.weighting: Equal weight, ten categories; judgment of current evidenced customer value, not roadmap potential.

categories.rationale: Useful evidence-led preparation for one vacancy and an honest MBA/employment distinction. It offers limited help constructing a persuasive functional pivot, assessing target-industry fit or finding the right recruiting channel.

MBA context carries into a clear, account-free six-step check with labeled inputs. The reusable career-record journey is sign-in gated and source forms suggest significant per-claim setup. It is unverified live.

Readable desktop and mobile layouts, labeled controls, progress, focus changes and functioning mobile navigation. Long review content adds scanning effort. Full keyboard, screen-reader, contrast and cross-device audits were not performed.

Literal source passages, academic labels, candid uncertainty, approval gates and separate evidence reports are strong. Downloaded PDF/DOCX/TXT preserved synthetic facts. Formatting is basic and semantic pivot evidence is conservative; private packet output remains unverified.

Pasted jobs are usable, but inspected discovery defaults to only three employer boards, with at most four configured feeds. There is no demonstrated consulting/product/strategy MBA market coverage; role and fit scoring mainly use lexical overlap.

One-check processing and downloads are straightforward. Code supports reusable confirmed claims and scheduled rules preparation, but first-time confirmation burden is high and actual recurring operation and time savings were not observed.

Source provides status stages, notes, due follow-ups, next actions and activity records. No private pipeline was observed, and no integrated MBA recruiting-event, referral or structured interview-round workflow was demonstrated.

Public check and all three exports completed; route recovery preserved text and reset approval. Cloud recovery controls look deliberate in source. Scheduler uptime, account recovery and provider failures are unverified; public support requires sign-in.

Local guest processing, optional refresh retention, separate saving/provider/inbox consent and granular claim control are strong. Cloud enforcement was not independently tested, and account-wide deletion requires a request while separate stores retain separate data.

I would try the free check. I would not yet buy a recurring subscription without demonstrated relevant vacancy supply and measurable preparation savings over a career-service adviser, generic tools and a spreadsheet. No real purchase behavior was tested.

evidence.finding: Repository HEAD equals the requested commit.
Home MBA selection changed examples and links to audience=mba; /for-mba explicitly separates prior employment, team contributions and forecast outcomes.
Free check is English literal evidence comparison with aliases, capped at 40 requirements. Private fit scoring uses title and phrase overlap. It is not a semantic career-pivot assessment.

Synthetic strategy vacancy produced 10 findings: 2 direct, 2 related, 3 missing, 3 manual. Employment reporting matched; MBA research support stayed related and academic; future MBA completion, authorization and deadline stayed manual. The vacancy title itself became a finding with irrelevant CV identity passages. There was no fabricated consulting experience or realized forecast.

PDF preview reported one page. Approval enabled downloads. All three browser download events completed. DOCX text equaled TXT ignoring its trailing newline. PDF text extracted with installed PyMuPDF equaled TXT after whitespace normalization, including dash code points and the forecast disclaimer. PDF was one page and 60,022 bytes. Exact preview/download byte identity is source-supported, not independently hashed live.
evidence.reference: src/pages/CvCheck.tsx:211; src/lib/document-export.ts; downloaded synthetic CV-Strategy Associate files

evidence.finding: At 390x844, approval content and MBA landing were readable; mobile menu exposed expected links and navigated successfully. Guest check clientWidth and scrollWidth were both 375, with no horizontal document overflow at the measured state.

After navigating from the guest check through Job Loop sign-in and returning via Free CV check, complete synthetic text returned at step six. Approval and preview were cleared. Returning to the generic /check route also removed MBA guidance because the audience query was absent.
Private Job Loop redirected an unauthenticated visitor to /auth?next=%2Floop. No account was used; private capabilities are not live-verified.

Default feeds are Careem, GoCardless and Duolingo on Greenhouse; configuration permits at most four Greenhouse/Lever feeds, capped reads of 100 records, and target title/location filtering. Broad search is conditional on configuration; its snippets remain unverified and packets are held. Live vacancy supply and configured feeds were not inspected.

Private code contains saved/prepared/applied/interview/offer/rejected/withdrawn status stages, notes, dated follow-ups, due-action cards and activity. Preparing a packet does not mark an application submitted. No real pipeline was exercised.

Schedule UI supports daily/weekdays/weekly local time, explicit timezone, opt-in, next run, pause/cancel and run history. It depends on scheduler readiness and pilot availability. UI saves a rules-only schedule; no real scheduled run or reminder delivery was tested.

Claim validation preserves complete literal passages, context and projection qualifiers. Factual edits/withdrawals invalidate packets. External model/inbox access require separate consent. Review/export is version bound. Backend behavior was inspected, not executed against a live private account.

Public Contact displayed sign-in for private support without a visible support email in the observed UI. Source distinguishes request receipt from review and loop erasure from account-wide erasure. Actual support resolution and deletion enforcement remain unverified.
Pricing displayed free pilot for the first ten accounts, proposed $15 Focus and $29 Job Loop tiers, and disabled checkout. No automatic conversion or paid offer was claimed.

top_five_actions.action: Demonstrate consulting, product and strategy vacancy coverage for MBA pivots.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a repeatable, dated benchmark spanning the three role families and at least two target locations, with at least 30 known relevant employer postings.
Recover at least 80% of benchmark vacancies and achieve at least 90% human-rated relevance in the first ten results per profile.
Every surfaced role shows employer source, checked date, coverage scope and explicit unknown eligibility; failed reads never count as a zero-job success.
top_five_actions.why: Job supply is the largest weakness behind subscription value.

top_five_actions.action: Add a sourced transferable-evidence review for career pivots.
acceptance_criteria: On 30 labeled synthetic pivot cases, at least 90% of expert-labeled transferable examples surface for review.
Show direct wording, potentially transferable evidence and genuine gaps as distinct outcomes with verbatim source passages.
No case promotes MBA project support to management ownership, a forecast to realized revenue, or an expected MBA to a completed credential.
Vacancy title and employer identity are excluded from requirement counts in all benchmark cases.
top_five_actions.why: Literal overlap helps honesty but misses the central MBA need to explain transfer.

top_five_actions.action: Reduce the first career-record setup burden and prove reuse.
acceptance_criteria: At least four of five new MBA testers reach a reviewed first packet from a mixed employment/project CV within 12 minutes, without coaching.
The same users prepare a second vacancy within three minutes without re-entering their CV or reconfirming unchanged claims.
Contribution, academic/employment context and projected/measured status remain visible and editable; every correction invalidates the affected approval.
top_five_actions.why: The source currently exposes a detailed claim editor before recurring savings can be realized.

top_five_actions.action: Connect recruiting milestones, pipeline and next actions.
acceptance_criteria: Support an employer deadline with local time and timezone, referral follow-up and interview-round milestone from one opportunity.
A user can record and find each next action in under 60 seconds and export a usable calendar reminder.
All benchmark dates retain the intended timezone; overdue actions surface correctly; preparing a document never records an application as sent.
top_five_actions.why: MBA recruiting is driven by deadlines, referrals and multiple rounds, beyond a status dropdown.

top_five_actions.action: Prove the private loop and paid value with an observable pilot.
acceptance_criteria: In a controlled pilot, each enrolled tester completes record → two relevant opportunities → approved export → tracked application → scheduled rules run → pause/cancel, with visible event receipts.
Demonstrate expired-session recovery, one failed source, unavailable scheduler and claim correction without data loss, silent success or stale download.
Provide a contact route usable during account-access problems and a clear account-wide erasure scope and completion receipt.

Before charging, at least six of ten MBA testers independently report at least 30 minutes saved across five applications and voluntarily choose the proposed subscription at its stated price; record all refusals and reasons.
top_five_actions.why: Private functionality and recurring economic value are currently source-supported rather than demonstrated in this review.

conclusion: 64.2/100. A credible free evidence-and-export tool; a less proven MBA pivot and recurring recruiting companion. I would use the free check and withhold subscription purchase pending relevant job coverage and observed time savings. No hiring outcome guarantee or prediction is made.
